title: Human Map / Nexus of Being — Developed Multiscale State Theory
status: Great Book archaeology + developed latent-state and measurement theory; not a validated biomarker of enlightenment
abstract: The Human Map is most valuable as a multiscale measurement theory of changing human state rather than as a table of mystical biological constants. The original Great Book formulas attempted to combine oscillations, connectivity, neuromodulation, CSF rhythms, graph structure, predictive coding, affect, social synchrony and phenomenological labels, but often mixed units or assigned unsupported fixed values to complex states. This redevelopment converts the material into a hierarchical generative model. A latent state z_t evolves through time, observations y_t are emitted through modality-specific measurement functions, and subject/session/context effects are represented explicitly. The theory distinguishes state from trait, measurement from interpretation, and neural dynamics from self-report. It adds identifiability criteria, Fisher-information analysis, hidden semi-Markov dwell structure, continuous stochastic dynamics, multimodal fusion, intervention logic and out-of-sample model comparison. The project-specific insight retained from the Human Map is that no single frequency, transmitter or network statistic should define a person or a state; the meaningful object is the structured relation among multiple channels and transitions. The branch is T2 as a statistical/neuroscience research programme and T0 as any claim that it measures a metaphysical rank such as enlightenment.
research_question: Can a hierarchical latent-state model of neural, physiological, behavioral and phenomenological data discover reproducible state structure and transitions that predict meaningful outcomes better than simple single-metric or static baselines?

core_generative_model.plain_language: the state is inferred from many noisy measurements; it is not identified with any one measurement

physiology: CSF variables only when measured appropriately
measurement_model.rule: each channel retains its own units and noise model before fusion

hidden_semi_markov_extension.duration: p(d|z=k) explicitly models dwell time rather than forcing geometric durations
hidden_semi_markov_extension.meaning: states are characterized not only by what measurements look like but by how long they persist and how transitions occur

continuous_landscape_extension.stationary_idea: p(z) proportional to exp[-2U(z)/sigma^2] only under restrictive gradient/isotropic conditions
continuous_landscape_extension.barrier: transition rates depend on barrier geometry and noise rather than on a mystical frequency constant
continuous_landscape_extension.project_value: the Human Map can become a state landscape with basins, transitions and interventions

identifiability.fisher: I_ab(theta)=E[(partial log p(y|theta)/partial theta_a)(partial log p(y|theta)/partial theta_b)]
identifiability.local_identifiability: full-rank Fisher information is a local diagnostic when regularity conditions apply
identifiability.profile_likelihood: use when parameters trade off strongly
identifiability.latent_symmetry_warning: latent-state labels can be permuted; orientation/sign/scaling may also be unidentified depending on the model
identifiability.lesson: a beautiful latent representation is not scientifically interpretable if multiple parameterizations produce the same data

multimodal_fusion.conditional_independence_example: p(y_EEG,y_HRV,y_report|z)=product_m p(y_m|z) only if the assumption is justified
multimodal_fusion.correlated_noise_option: use a joint covariance or shared nuisance latent variables when modalities share motion, arousal or task timing
multimodal_fusion.missing_data: integrate over unobserved modalities rather than imputing a state label from one absent channel
multimodal_fusion.calibration: measurement reliability and session drift should be estimated separately from true state change

state_trait_decomposition.meaning: persistent individual difference and temporary state change are distinct scientific questions

intervention_and_causality.controlled_input: u_t may represent task, stimulation, breathing condition, meditation instruction or another declared intervention
intervention_and_causality.causal_question: does changing u alter transition probabilities, dwell times or outcomes after confound control?
intervention_and_causality.counterfactual_boundary: observational state correlations alone do not establish that a neural feature causes a phenomenological state

recovered_formula_repair_principles: Do not add neurotransmitter concentration, EEG power, graph metrics and psychological scores directly without a typed statistical model.
Replace fixed 'enlightenment' frequencies/fractal dimensions with estimated distributions and uncertainty.
Replace ad hoc predictive-coding scores with an explicit generative Bayesian model.
Replace raw covariance synchrony with normalized/source-aware metrics and nuisance controls.
Keep the valid logarithmic Consciousness Spiral as geometry; test it against alternative trajectory models if applied to data.

worked_observation_example.latent: z_t=(arousal,integration,stability) as an exploratory 3D state, not canonical biology
worked_observation_example.test: compare held-out likelihood and behavioral prediction against EEG-only and report-only baselines
worked_observation_example.value: this illustrates how heterogeneous measurements can constrain one latent state without pretending they have common physical units

model_comparison.rule: more latent dimensions are justified only when they improve prediction or stable interpretation

operationalization_of_enlightenment_like.rule: never use 'enlightenment' as a biological constant
operationalization_of_enlightenment_like.validation: require convergent measures, reliability, discriminant validity and replication
operationalization_of_enlightenment_like.boundary: a latent state may correlate with a chosen construct without exhausting its philosophical or spiritual meaning

failure_conditions: Latent states are unstable across preprocessing choices or datasets.
The complex model fails to outperform simpler baselines out of sample.
State labels depend primarily on motion, muscle, respiration, cardiac or source-leakage artifacts.
Parameters are practically non-identifiable or posterior estimates are prior-dominated.
A proposed biomarker lacks measurement invariance across subjects/sessions relevant to the claim.
Inter-brain synchrony is interpreted as direct causal/quantum coupling without excluding common input and coordination.
next_decisive_work: Select one operational target and one dataset/experimental design.
Fit a small HMM/HSMM or linear dynamical system before nonlinear alternatives.
Add one intervention to test whether transitions can be manipulated predictably.
Replicate before promoting any Human Map feature to a canonical biomarker.
